dict.string: Gatita sends prompts between your own devices on this network, so a phone or another Mac can ask a host for replies.
Gatita listens only after you press the mic button, until you press it again, to type what you say into the message box.
Gatita turns what you say into text for the message box, with Apple's speech recognition.
Gatita reads your events when you ask about your schedule. It never changes them.
